items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: And every New Years, we’re friends, his daughter, who now works for him in the office, I knew her when she was a little girl. Marissa.

ctx.x: Great pleasure. On behalf of the Hamilton College I thank you for joining us today. Have a good gig tonight.
Thank you. We’re going to try. Lord knows we’re going to try. Thank you. SR: [inaudible]

Oh, are we still rolling? Being at the right place at the right time is very important. And my career has always been that way. For most of us who were in the television/radio business, and many, many years ago I was the band leader at the Rainbow Room. The © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -16-
